chart.name: Tasks overview
chart.programText:
A = data('QueuedTasks', filter=filter('namespace', 'AmazonMWAA') and filter('stat', 'sum')).sum(by=['Environment', 'Function']).publish(label='A')

C = data('TasksExecutable', filter=filter('namespace', 'AmazonMWAA') and filter('stat', 'sum')).sum(by=['Environment', 'Function']).publish(label='C')
D = data('TasksStarving', filter=filter('namespace', 'AmazonMWAA') and filter('stat', 'sum')).sum(by=['Environment', 'Function']).publish(label='D')
